stores.location: Room Durable Object storage, key "room", one object per room name

export.description: examples/migration.ts exportAll(snapshot): a header line, then one room line per room in sorted id order with a sha256 over its canonical JSON. The application reads the snapshot from storage (for example a protected route in a subclass of the Room class). The room list is exported by room-directory.

import.description: examples/migration.ts importAll(text): verifies header, counts, checksums, duplicates and storage layout number, then returns records the application writes back with storage.put.

verification.checksums: sha256 per record over canonical JSON (keys sorted at every level)

cannotPreserve: open live connections and waiting long polls (clients reconnect)
scheduled alarms (set again by the next change in each room; a game clock waiting on an alarm resumes only after a request reaches that room)
ordering of changes made while the export runs
game state the new application's GameAdapter.restore rejects

notes: maxMegabytes is the Workers Free account storage limit (5 GB) from https://developers.cloudflare.com/durable-objects/platform/limits/; a single stored room record must stay under 8 MB (key and value combined) on SQLite-backed objects. afterRemovalDays is the retention this package recommends for the exported file after the component is removed; Cloudflare keeps hosted objects until the owner deletes them. The export and import functions are real and tested; the storage read and write routes are written by the application because the extracted Room class has no export route.
